description: Pinned source versions for UniPad experiments (PRD 8.1 inputs). Every run must be reproducible from this file plus the recorded hashes.

unixnu.commit_note: M0 must pin an actual commit; null = not yet frozen. Do not build from a moving branch.

device_repo.commit_note: M0 must pin an actual commit; null = not yet frozen.

system_identity.discrepancy: PRD cites both build 21H161 (appendix A) and 21H461 (section 2.1 E04). M0 must resolve the exact build from the pinned board.toml / actual IPSW and update this field with evidence.

ipsw.note: Apple IPSW stays in local-private/ and is never committed (PRD 12).

qemu.note: M0 must record the exact qemu-system-aarch64 build and version; accelerator must be explicitly TCG on this Intel host.

xcode.note: macOS runner only; recorded from the Actions job.

frozen_note: Set frozen=true only when every null above is filled with evidence.
